commit.message:
docs: match env.example to the live kernel stack; drop the end-to-end overclaim (#27)

* docs: match env.example to the live kernel stack; drop the end-to-end overclaim

The 240k full sample set vs the same-day control is median +0.3%
(deltas -3.2% to +7.4%) under ambient bursts — not +3-7.4%. Isolated
kernel receipts stay +41% (52 -> ~73.5 TFLOP/s), bit-exact x56.

env.example now ships the production knobs (IMAGE=glm53-selfbuild,
EXL3_FAT_SORTED/BATCHED/KERNEL=1) with the last public GHCR digest
kept as a commented fallback that does not export exl3_fat_gemm.
docs/02 records the flags; README provenance is un-mangled; docs/11
and docs/12 unify the S3 trigger on the measured incumbent (>= ~80
TFLOP/s, Amdahl +4-5% ceiling).

Co-authored-by: factory-droid[bot] <138933559+factory-droid[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

* docs/12: drop the leftover ~+7% end-to-end Trellis ceiling

Amdahl on the measured share is +4-5% at a perfect Trellis kernel
(92 TFLOP/s), not +7. Keep the burst-pass range as individual deltas,
not as the headline.

Co-authored-by: factory-droid[bot] <138933559+factory-droid[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

* docs/12: do not claim the Amdahl ceiling is what S2b landed

S2b's isolated +41% became a +0.3% full-set median under traffic.
End-to-end has to be measured; the ~+4-5% figure is a cap, not a
receipt.

Co-authored-by: factory-droid[bot] <138933559+factory-droid[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

---------

commit.message:
S2b window: cp.async pipeline adopted — ledgers (#26)

* docs: S2b window ledger — adopted cp.async pipeline, validation receipts, incident lesson

Co-authored-by: factory-droid[bot] <138933559+factory-droid[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

* README: performance parameters re-reviewed; kernel-wave callout; docs/12 re-anchored to measured post-S2b

Performance-parameter review against the current ledgers:
- Cold prefill row updated from the pre-W24 ~860-870 to the measured
  ~1000-1070 tok/s at 240k (kernel stack: fat GEMM + ticket scheduler +
  3-stage cp.async pipeline; same-day controls; idle re-bench pending).
- Prose tok/s promoted to the headline figure as the most reliable
  real-workload parameter; structured decode reframed as the
  acceptance/quality gate rather than the throughput headline.
- New row: multi-agent concurrency (4 in-flight, warm follow-ups 2.6 s
  behind a running generation, mixed-prefill gate v3 numbers, and the
  ~50,176-token cached-conversation capacity ceiling from the W41 log).
- Prefill-vs-content note: tokens/s is content-independent (compute-bound);
  tokens per document is not (code/JSON densify).
- Fixes-table retention rows updated to the current per-group mechanism
  (W25); short-TTFT row updated to the gate-v3 band.
- Exclusivity clause gains the kernel stack as the fifth load-bearing item;
  experiments-that-lost gains the row-tiling rejection (-20.9% kill-arm).
- New reader callout: the recent CUDA kernel rewrites, their receipts,
  the validation gates, and the JIT-cache caveat.

docs/12: S3 bar re-anchored on the measured post-S2b incumbent (~73.5
TFLOP/s measured; meaningful margin >= ~80; Amdahl cap ~+6-7% end-to-end
at the measured ~25-30% fat share). Sections 1/5/8 consistent.

Co-authored-by: factory-droid[bot] <138933559+factory-droid[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

* docs: correct end-to-end prefill claims to the full-set receipts; unify S3 trigger arithmetic

The 240k full sample set {906.0, 966.2, 970.6, 1031.4, 1071.9} vs the
997.8 control gives full-set median 1001.0 = +0.3% (deltas -3.2% to
+7.4%) - the earlier +3-7.4% phrasing relied on ad-hoc clean-subset
medians. Corrected across docs/06, docs/11, README, docs/12; the
end-to-end verdict is UNRESOLVED pending the idle-box re-bench and the
disposition is provisional-on-kernel-evidence. Fat-kernel share revised
to 'well below the 61% FLOP bound (order ~20-30%)'. docs/12: Amdahl
ranges corrected (80 TFLOP/s -> +2.1-2.5%; 92 -> +4.2-5.3%), the >= ~80
TFLOP/s trigger unified across sections 1/5/8, projection-era language
removed from docs/11 and spec/TODO. README fixes-table short-TTFT row
updated to the current 6.7-7.9 s gate-v3 band.

Co-authored-by: factory-droid[bot] <138933559+factory-droid[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Reederey <reederey@Reedereys-Mac-Studio.local>
Co-authored-by: factory-droid[bot] <138933559+factory-droid[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

v1.3.0: self-built production image — parity sync, cutover + A/B ledger docs, README (#9)

* v1.3.0: self-build parity sync, cutover + A/B ledger docs, README for the self-build era

- Dockerfile/start.sh: sync to the tree production builds from (kpool tail
  slot-map clamp wired at build and runtime; newer env passthroughs and
  per-node GID handling; env.example naming kept). Abliteration machinery
  remains excluded from this repo by policy.
- overlay: add patch_kpool_tail_slotmap.py; sync exl3.py (fat-expert
  prefill diagnostics + temp-rows knob).
- tests: add test_kpool_tail_slotmap.py.
- docs/10-selfbuild-production.md: the production cutover to the image this
  repo builds, gates, the same-night A/B ledger (#54282 salt adopted;
  LPTT/MNBT config and radix top-k tested-and-rejected with numbers), the
  four load-bearing components, rollback drill.
- docs/08: postscript measuring the community 7168/3584 prefill config.
- README: rewritten for the self-build era (build step in quickstart,
  measured table refreshed incl. 500k-with-drafter and replay rows,
  rebase track marked executed).

* docs: address release review — rollback ladder mapped to images, throughput ranges stated directly, regression range vs full baseline, gate references + replay denominators, ownership and prefill-scope wording
